description: Criterios territoriales y paisajísticos específicos a tener en cuenta para la implantación de centrales fotovoltaicas en la Comunitat Valenciana is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by terramapas.icv.gva.es. WMS (Web map service) service that provides representation of necessary layers to analyze compliance with the provisions of article 10 of Decree-Law 14 / 2020, of the Consell, of Measures to accelerate the implementation of facilities for the use of renewable energies. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Specific territorial and landscape criteria to be taken into account for the implementation of photovoltaic power pl" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OGC:WMS-1.3.0, WMS, ICV_CLAS:Energy, OGC, Instalaciones Fotovoltaicas, ICV_CLAS:Energia. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
